component.name: Eduka-Block
component.summary: Intelligent multilingual web protection for Edukasaun OS

description.p: Eduka-Block helps parents and teachers block harmful websites, domains, subdomains, IP addresses and CIDR ranges for all users of an Edukasaun OS computer.
It combines wildcard DNS, a managed /etc/hosts section, nftables, category blocklists, SafeSearch and encrypted-DNS anti-bypass below the browser layer. One click turns on the recommended protection.
The interface defaults to International English and includes Tetum, European Portuguese, Brazilian Portuguese and Indonesian.
Subdomain filtering now works on systems that use systemd-resolved, blocking a platform also blocks its related domains, a Turn off protection button, and a separate Squid Proxy page.
Official logo, account recovery for forgotten usernames and passwords (sign-in screen and eduka-block-reset), and safe installation inside image builders such as Cubic.

Redesigned interface with dashboard and one-click recommended protection, category lists for adult content, gambling, social media and malware, SafeSearch and encrypted-DNS anti-bypass, browser policies, and a single-file offline installer.

Rule import and export, multi-rule removal, manual IP synchronisation, fixed firewall failures with overlapping IP ranges, Debian 13 PolicyKit dependencies, a non-freezing interface and complete translations.
Subtle 3D interface, red blocked-rule indicators, confirmed five-character-minimum passwords, and hardened atomic nftables and localhost-only Squid configuration.
Compact small-screen layout, login account changes and optional Squid keyword filtering.
Flat boxed interface with consistent spacing and adaptive GTK theme colours.
Multilingual interface, adaptive GTK theme and intelligent multi-layer blocking.
